label: Sweep one geometric parameter over three points, reusing what already exists
notes: TEST EXAMPLE - edit before running. solve_policy ALLOW_UP_TO_N with max_solves 3 is a CEILING, not a promise: any point whose (reuse_signature, hashes) already exists in the reuse index is read instead of solved, and the plan lists every point as reused / new / reuse-denied before the first solve. If you would rather never solve, use solve_policy REUSE_ONLY with the SOLVE stage still listed - the planner then converts that stage into reuse decisions. Each point needs its own fixture_definition and project_path here in case they differ per point; both may also be declared once at spec level and shared. Run this with reuse_index passed to the plan/run call to get reuse between sweeps.
